signals.advisor_quote: I spend too much time on account paperwork, so better operations support would matter.
signals.rationale: The advisor directly identifies operational burden and states that better support would matter.

signals.advisor_quote: I would need confidence that my clients will not have a disruptive transition before I make a move.
signals.rationale: The advisor states client-transition confidence as a required condition before moving.

signals.advisor_quote: I am open to reviewing the details, but I am not planning a change this quarter.
signals.rationale: The advisor expresses openness while directly limiting near-term timing.
